paragraphs.text: One-click expand-all for the DSH sidebar session list, with strict collapse-to-5.
# dsh-sidebar-expand-all
One-click **expand all** for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar — expanded by default, with a strict **col
xpand all** for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar — expanded by default, with a strict **collapse to 5**.
DSH 侧栏默认只展开 5 个会话；这个插件让它**默认全部展开**，「展开其余 N 个会话」点一次展开该工作区**全部**剩余会话，点「收起」严格回到 5 个。
> 中文说明见 README.zh.md。
## A note on the two run paths
If you run this from a DSH **host plugin** (the packaged `/dsh-sidebar-expand-all` control page), th
e code runs inside Electron, where `node:fs` resolves `app.asar` as a *directory* — `statSync().isFi
le()` is `false` and `openSync()` throws `ENOENT`. This package therefore reads the archive through
Electron's `original-fs` (falling back to `process.noAsar`) whenever it detects `process.versions.el
ectron`. If you patch from a plain terminal, the ordinary `node:fs` path is used instead. Both were
verified against a real install.
> The marketplace renders its install button with `--profile web`. On DSH Desktop, use `--profile de
sktop` instead — that is the profile the app actually boots.
## What it changes
DSH stores a per-workspace "watermark": how many sessions of a group are visible. The upstream UI ad
vances it by `SESSION_WATERMARK_BASE = 5` on every click, and the collapsed baseline is raised whene
ver a running or unread session must stay visible.
That watermark lives **only in React component state** (`useState({})` — not persisted, reset on rem
ount), so patching just the click handler makes the sidebar fall back to 5 sessions after a restart.
Hence the default is patched to `Infinity` too.
This plugin applies four **same-length** patches to the bundled client at
[代码示例省略，未执行]
| Patch | Official code | Patched code | Effect |
| `toggle-all` | the whole `onClick` (`if (sessionsExpanded) { dropWatermarks(...); return; }` plus
the `visible.hiddenCount <= SESSION_WATERMARK_BASE ? Infinity : watermark + SESSION_WATERMARK_BASE`
ternary) | `setStoredWatermarks((marks) => ({ ...marks, [group.key]: sessionsExpanded ? SESSION_WATE
RMARK_BASE : Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY }))` | one click reveals every remaining session; collapse wri

tes back 5 |
| `collapse-baseline` | `Math.max(SESSION_WATERMARK_BASE, requiredWatermark(...))` | `S

ESSION_WATERMARK_BASE` | collapse always shows exactly 5 |
| `default-expanded` | `const watermark =
sessionWatermarks[group.key] ?? SESSION_WATERMARK_BASE;` | `... ?? Infinity;` | **expanded by defau

lt** |
| `default-expanded-drag` | `sessionWatermarks[group.key] ?? SESSION_WATERMARK_BASE).rows` |
`... ?? Infinity).rows` | drag ordering uses the same visible rows |
All replacements are padded with spaces so the file size does not change, and the entry's `integrity
.hash` (and `blocks[0].hash`) in the asar header is updated in place. Any change to file length woul
d corrupt every following entry in the archive.

## Use
### Web page
After DSH starts, open
[代码示例省略，未执行]
You get the current status of all four patches plus **Apply**, **Restore** and **Refresh** buttons.
> Installing the plugin does **not** modify anything by itself — it only serves this page and ships
the CLI. Nothing is written to `app.asar` until you press **Apply** (or run the CLI without flags).
Review what it will change first, then apply and restart DSH.
### CLI
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Exit codes: `0` ok · `2` asar or backup missing · `3` file/header integrity mismatch (refused) · `4`
check found inconsistent header.
### Restart is required
The DSH host caches every client bundle in memory at startup, and `dsh-client-hmr` keeps seeing the
startup-time `stat` of files inside `app.asar`, so **editing the asar cannot hot-reload**. Fully qui
t DSH and open it again (a page refresh is not enough).
## Safety
- Files are never resized: patches are equal-length and verified by re-reading the entry and its hea

der hash.
- The original `client.js` and the original asar header are backed up to `~/.dsh/dsh-sideb

ar-expand-all/.asar-bak/` before the first write (`DSH_BAK` overrides).
- Restore writes the backup

back and re-checks that backup header and content match.
- If the current content does not match the
header integrity (another tool already modified the archive), the apply step aborts instead of gues

sing.
- If a patch anchor is missing, the plugin reports `unsupported` and writes nothing — it never
guesses a replacement.
## Upgrades
A DSH upgrade replaces `app.asar` as a whole, so the patch disappears. Re-run **Apply** (or the CLI)
after upgrading. If the anchors changed in a new DSH release, the status becomes `unsupported`; the
four expressions above must then be re-located in the new `client.js`.
## Bundled skill
The plugin also installs a user-level skill to `~/.dsh/skills/dsh-sidebar-expand-all/`, so an agent
session can perform the same check/apply/restore without the web page.
## Development
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`lib/asar-patch.js` is dependency-free and can be used outside the plugin.
